name: Mass Heal

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: any number of creatures you can see

summary: Restore up to 700 Hit Points, split as you choose among creatures you can see, and end their Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned conditions.
text: Divide up to 700 Hit Points of healing among any number of creatures you can see in range. Each creature healed also loses the Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned conditions.
